responsibility: Implements SSA operand-cache construction and maintenance for GIMPLE statements. It scans statement trees to build real and virtual use/def operand vectors, updates operand caches after statement modification, maintains immediate-use links, supports operand swapping and VDEF unlinking, and provides verification and dump utilities; this file is the core infrastructure that lets tree SSA passes query and edit def-use chains efficiently.
same_name_distinction: Implements SSA operand-cache construction and maintenance, including scanning statements, building real/virtual use-def vectors, updating caches, maintaining immediate-use links, and verification/dump support. Unlike gcc/tree-ssa-operands.h, it contains the operand-management machinery itself rather than the operand types, macros, and declarations.
